title: Charles Burney and the 'ivory tower' of Urartian history

tellings.quote: region there was a man named Charles Bernie who was like the you could call him the grandfather of your Artin history

plain: The researcher Matt LaCroix, speaking with Michels about the Lake Van region of eastern Turkey, describes a scholar named Charles Burney as "the grandfather" of Urartian history, the study of the ancient kingdom of Urartu that once ruled there. LaCroix gives no source, and the story's title frames that field as an 'ivory tower'. He brings it up as part of a wider argument that something big happened in the deep past around 12,000 BC, earlier than the accepted history of the area allows.
